title: validate output
description: Printed with --json when the config loads. ok is true when every check passes (exit 0); otherwise ok is false and the exit is the exit code of the first failing check (20 refused with a reason, 12 for tool or host problems). When the config cannot load, the output is the error envelope with exit 2. probe is present only with --probe; a check named test_message is present only with --test-message.

probe.description: Present only with --probe. service_found is false when the API call failed.

message.description: Untrusted: may quote host text. Never contains the token.
